inventory.interpretation: The 186 aggregate AC1021 source-frame observer callbacks are 74 opaque carriers plus 112 standard-object frames. Bounded physical selected-output routes now qualify all 74 opaque carriers: 25 VISUALSTYLE, 17 SCALE, 12 DICTIONARYVAR, three MATERIAL, one DBCOLOR, one ACDBDICTIONARYWDFLT, one ACDBPLACEHOLDER, two ACDBSECTIONVIEWSTYLE, two ACDBDETAILVIEWSTYLE, one MLEADERSTYLE, one MLINESTYLE, one TABLESTYLE, one CELLSTYLEMAP, one RASTERVARIABLES, and one SORTENTSTABLE. They qualify 84 standard-object frames; output routes verify typed/raw readback and applicable dependency closure, refusal and retry. The remaining 28 standard-object frames remain unqualified; source-byte capture or matching typed callbacks alone do not qualify serialization.
